body.statement: Let \(C\subseteq U\) be the vertex sets of the target and current labelled source factors in a call to \(\operatorname{IDENTIFY}^{+}\), with \(G^{\leftrightarrow}[U]\) connected.  The algorithm forms the least \(H\), \(C\subseteq H\subseteq U\), for which no term outside \(H\) carries a value occurring in the parent subscript of a term inside \(H\).  It returns the marginal when \(H=C\), returns \(\operatorname{FAIL}\) when \(H=U\ne C\), and otherwise recurses on the unique bidirected district of \(G[H]\) containing \(C\).  Every such recursive call strictly decreases \(|U|\).
